name: MedTEC-Bench
description: A five-level diagnostic benchmark that probes whether the text encoder of dual-encoder medical vision-language models separates semantically distinct descriptions of a fixed image: domain, modality, anatomy, finding, and negation. Covers chest X-ray, brain MRI, abdominal CT, retinal fundus, dermoscopy, and histopathology. Released as prompt sets and anchor-image manifests; images are obtained from the original datasets.
citeAs: @inproceedings{akash2026medtec, title={When Medical VLMs Stop Understanding: MedTEC-Bench for Probing Semantic Specificity}, author={Akash, Ahsan Habib and Devkota, Alina and Adjeroh, Donald A. and Bhattarai, Binod and Gyawali, Prashnna Kumar}, booktitle={Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (Evaluations and Datasets Track)}, year={2026}}
rai:dataCollection: Anchor images are sampled (seed 42, stratified, single-label) from public medical imaging datasets; prompts were written by the authors from clinical label vocabularies, with negation phrasings drawn from NegEx, ConText and the Panicek-Hricak certainty lexicon.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Single-label filtering and per-class stratified sampling to about 1,000 anchors per modality; CT anchors use a windowed representative axial slice for 2D models and the full volume for MERLIN. Selection scripts: scripts/select_*_probes.py, scripts/build_ct_disease_probes.py.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: No new image annotation. Labels come from the source datasets; prompt positives and negatives are assigned from those labels.
rai:dataUseCases: Diagnostic evaluation of the text-side semantic discrimination of dual-encoder medical VLMs. Not validated for image-side grounding, generative or cross-attention models, or for any clinical decision.
rai:dataLimitations: English prompts only; template-based wording (robustness variants are provided); one representative slice per CT scan for 2D models; source-dataset label noise is inherited. Passing every level is necessary, not sufficient, for clinical use.
rai:dataBiases: Demographic composition is inherited from the source datasets. Subgroup analysis (paper Appendix L) finds a small skin-tone gradient (gap at most 0.044 DS at L1-L3) and sex and age gaps at most 0.019; finding-level skin-tone evaluation is not covered.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None released. Manifests contain only source-dataset image IDs and labels, plus the de-identified sex, age and skin-type fields already public in ISIC/HAM10000. No images or reports are redistributed.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Intended to expose clinically relevant failures of medical VLMs before deployment. Risk: over-reliance on the benchmark as a certification; it must not replace clinical validation or non-AI safeguards.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Maintained by the authors at the GitHub repository; issues and corrections are tracked there and versioned releases are tagged.

distribution.name: prompt-files
distribution.description: Per-modality L1-L5 prompt sets, wording variants (clinical, ontology, report style) and literature-grounded negation ladders.

distribution.name: cxr-manifest
distribution.description: Chest X-ray anchors: 1,000 frontal single-label images, 5 findings. Source: NIH ChestX-ray14. 1000 records.

distribution.name: brain_mri-manifest
distribution.description: Brain MRI anchors: 1,000 axial slices, 4 dementia stages. Source: OASIS-1. 1000 records.

distribution.name: abdominal_ct-manifest
distribution.description: Abdominal CT anchors: 900 scans (150 per finding), 6 findings. Source: Merlin abdominal CT. 900 records.

distribution.name: fundus-manifest
distribution.description: Retinal fundus anchors: 1,004 images, 7 ocular disease classes. Source: ODIR-5K. 1004 records.

distribution.name: dermoscopy-manifest
distribution.description: Dermoscopy anchors: 1,000 images, 5 lesion types. Source: ISIC 2018 Task 3 / HAM10000. 1000 records.

distribution.name: histopathology-manifest
distribution.description: Histopathology anchors: 999 patches, 9 tissue classes. Source: NCT-CRC-HE-100K (CRC-VAL-HE-7K). 999 records.

distribution.name: openi_cxr-manifest
distribution.description: OpenI chest radiographs used for the unified evaluation (Section 5.3). Source: OpenI Indiana University CXR. 3295 records.

distribution.name: skin_tone-manifest
distribution.description: Dermoscopy subset with Fitzpatrick skin type, for the subgroup analysis. Source: ISIC archive collection 413. 900 records.

distribution.name: sex_age-manifest
distribution.description: Dermoscopy subset with patient sex and approximate age, for the subgroup analysis. Source: HAM10000. 1000 records.

distribution.name: roco_cxr_captions
distribution.description: Captions of the 354-pair chest-radiograph subset of the ROCO test split (retrieval pool).

distribution.name: roco_cxr_filter
distribution.description: Filter definition for the ROCO-CXR pool.
